candidates.name: Cerebral amyloid angiopathy
support_spans: Multiple small foci of restricted diffusion in the anterior, middle, and posterior cerebral artery territories
Widespread microhaemorrhages
candidates.why: The patient's brain MRI shows multiple small foci of restricted diffusion and widespread microhaemorrhages, which are consistent with cerebral amyloid angiopathy.

candidates.name: Thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura
support_spans: Blood film showed auto-agglutination with macro-aggregates of red cells up to 100 μm in length and rouleaux
candidates.why: The patient's blood film shows auto-agglutination with macro-aggregates of red cells, which is consistent with thrombotic thrombocytopenic purpura.

candidates.name: Disseminated intravascular coagulation
support_spans: Elevated D-dimer
Elevated fibrinogen
candidates.why: The patient's laboratory tests show elevated D-dimer and fibrinogen, which are consistent with disseminated intravascular coagulation.

candidates.name: Antiphospholipid syndrome
support_spans: Coombs-positive autoimmune haemolytic anaemia
Elevated tumor markers
candidates.why: The patient's medical history includes Coombs-positive autoimmune haemolytic anaemia, and laboratory tests show elevated tumor markers, which are consistent with antiphospholipid syndrome.

candidates.name: Cerebral vasculitis
support_spans: Multiple small foci of restricted diffusion in the anterior, middle, and posterior cerebral artery territories
candidates.why: The patient's brain MRI shows multiple small foci of restricted diffusion, which could be consistent with cerebral vasculitis, and would require further imaging or pathology to confirm.

candidates.name: Thromboembolic disease
support_spans: Multiple echogenic targets with snowflake appearance in all four heart chambers
Rapid swirling motion detected on M-mode imaging
candidates.why: The patient's transthoracic echocardiography shows multiple echogenic targets and rapid swirling motion, which are consistent with thromboembolic disease, and would require further imaging or pathology to confirm.
